title: Photograph 6
reviewAlt: A woman presses a light-colored cloth against the outside front glass of an empty display case. Her other hand rests on its frame.
audioScript: A. A woman is serving food to a customer. B. A woman is opening a door at the back of the room. C. A woman is wiping the glass of a display case. D. A woman is washing a tray in a sink.
